meta.title: Collagen Stick Buyer Benchmark
meta.description: Picture ranking of nine Korean fish collagen stick products, followed by a plain-language guide to collagen, molecular size, vitamin C and reading the label.

p1.title: Which collagen stick should you buy?
p1.lead: We checked the labels of 9 Korean fish collagen sticks. The score shows how good the inside of the stick is. Higher score = better product. More coloured blocks = better. Price is shown on the right, but it does not change the score.
p1.foot: ◆ = number from the seller's website, not printed on the box. Pages 2 to 9 explain each column in simple words. The exact formula is on the last page.

p2.title: Collagen is the spring inside your skin
p2.artLabel: Two pieces of skin. Young skin has many collagen fibres. Older skin has fewer.
p2.pt1: Collagen is a protein. It makes long, strong threads inside your skin, bones and joints.
p2.pt2: Think of a mattress. Collagen threads are the springs that keep skin firm and bouncy.
p2.pt3: As we get older, the body slowly makes less collagen. That is why people buy collagen drinks and sticks.
p2.typesTitle: There are different types. For skin, you want Type I.
p2.t1d: Skin, hair, nails, bones. About 9 out of 10 parts of your body's collagen. Comes from fish or cow.
p2.t2d: Joints and knees. Comes from chicken. Not used for skin products.
p2.t3d: Skin and blood vessels. Works next to Type I. Comes from cow or pig.
p2.rule: All 9 products here use fish collagen. Fish collagen is Type I, the skin type. Good.

p3.title: Da tells you how big the collagen pieces are. Smaller is better.
p3.artLabel: Big collagen pieces stop at the gut wall. Small pieces pass through into the blood.
p3.wall: Gut wall: only very small pieces fit through the gap →
p3.pt1: Da (dalton) is how scientists weigh very small things like molecules. Big number = big piece. Small number = small piece.
p3.pt2: Collagen is a long chain of tiny beads. Makers cut the chain into short pieces so the body can take it in.
p3.pt3: The gut takes in pieces of 2 or 3 beads most easily. That is about 300 Da. Pieces of 1,000 or 2,000 Da must be cut smaller by the body first.
p3.scaleLabel: Scale: 300 Da is best, 1,000 Da is okay, 2,000 Da is weak, not on the box means ask the seller.
p3.rule: Look for "평균분자량" (average molecular weight) on the box. 300 Da or lower is the best you can buy.

p4.title: Small pieces are good. But you also need enough of them.
p4.lead: In skin studies, people took 2,500 mg or more of collagen a day. The dashed line shows that amount. Longer bar = more collagen in one stick.
p4.rule: Yorosum gives the most collagen per stick: 2,000 mg. VITASUB gives only 196 mg, 10 times less.

p5.title: Vitamin C is the builder that turns collagen pieces into skin
p5.artLabel: Without vitamin C the bricks stay in a pile. With vitamin C they become a strong wall.
p5.dv: 100 mg vitamin C = 100% of one day's need (Korea)
p5.pt1: Collagen pieces are like bricks. Vitamin C is the builder. Without it, the body cannot build strong new collagen.
p5.pt2: Vitamin C does not push collagen into the blood. Its job comes after that: it helps build the collagen in your skin.
p5.pt3: A good stick gives about 100 mg, one full day of vitamin C. We give 10/10 at 100 mg or more.

p6.title: Don't be fooled by fancy words on the box
p6.lead: Many boxes say "Glutathione", "Biotin" or "Hyaluronic acid" in big letters. But the amount inside is often a tiny drop. A tiny drop does nothing.
p6.rule: A long list of extras is not a sign of quality. Check the amount in mg. If it is tiny, ignore it.

p7.title: Find the real collagen amount in 3 steps
p7.lead: Many boxes show a percentage (%), not milligrams. Here is how to turn it into mg. Example: HURUM Small Molecular.
p7.artLabel: Example label: fish collagen 60 percent, 2 grams times 60 sticks.
p7.s2: Find the weight of one stick (포 = stick). 1 g = 1,000 mg.
p7.s3: Multiply. This is the real collagen in one stick.
p7.ssfAlt: SSF pomegranate collagen jelly stick box
p7.warnTitle: Watch out for big box numbers
p7.warnText: The SSF box says "100,000 mg" collagen. That is for the whole box of 100 sticks. One stick has 1,000 mg. Always count per stick.
p7.glossTitle: Korean words to know on the box
p7.g6: General food. Not a health functional food (건강기능식품), so the box cannot promise health results.

p8.title: Compare price per gram of collagen, not price per box
p8.lead: Boxes have 30 to 100 sticks, so the box price can trick you. Divide the price by the total grams of collagen in the box. Shorter bar = cheaper collagen.
p8.rule: BOTO has the cheapest box (₩8,630). But its collagen costs more per gram than HURUM or Yorosum, and the pieces are big (2,000 Da).

p9.title: 6 questions before you buy
p9.c2: Is the Da on the box, and is it 300 Da or lower?
p9.c3: Is there at least 1,000 mg collagen per stick? 2,000 mg or more is best.
p9.c4: Is there about 100 mg vitamin C per stick?
p9.c5: Are the extras big enough to matter, or just tiny drops?
p9.c6: What is the price per gram of collagen?

p10.title: All numbers and the scoring formula
p10.tableNote: ◆ Not printed on the front pack (seller listing). Confirm with the supplier's certificate of analysis.
p10.w4: Clean formula: extras at useful doses, no filler (judged)
p10.formulaNote: Score = weighted average of the four rows (2 : 2 : 1.5 : 1.5, about 29%, 29%, 21%, 21%). Price is not part of the score because retail prices change often and wholesale prices differ; price per gram is shown separately. Glutathione, biotin and hyaluronic acid earn no points below studied doses (glutathione 250–1,000 mg/day; hyaluronic acid 120–240 mg/day; biotin 30 µg only meets the daily adequate intake).
p10.notesSum: Strengths and weaknesses of each product

foot.f1: Per-stick amounts are calculated from percentages and stick weights printed on each pack. MIPPEUM figures and the HURUM Small Molecular 300 Da figure come from seller listings. Prices are the last retail prices checked; request current wholesale quotes.
foot.f2: This guide compares product labels for buying decisions. It is not medical advice and makes no health claims for any product. YOROSUM is the publisher's own brand; the full scoring formula is shown so anyone can check it.

js.biotinTitle: Biotin in BB LAB and HURUM Biotin
js.biotinText: 30 µg is one day's basic need, which normal food already gives. More biotin does not improve skin or hair unless you lack it.

yorosum.name: YOROSUM Glow Peptide
yorosum.extras: Peach flavour powder 300 mg, bamboo sap extract 30 mg, elastin 3 mg
yorosum.pros: Most collagen per stick (2,000 mg); 300 Da printed on pack; 100 mg vitamin C; second-cheapest per gram.
yorosum.cons: About 0.57 g per stick not itemised on front pack; elastin is a trace amount; ₩663 per stick.

hurum-sm.name: HURUM Small Molecular Fish Collagen
hurum-sm.pros: Cheapest per gram (₩319/g); 120 mg vitamin C; short, clean formula.
hurum-sm.cons: 1,200 mg is under half the 2,500 mg benchmark; 300 Da not on front pack.

ssf.name: SSF Real Pomegranate Collagen Jelly
ssf.extras: Pomegranate concentrate 18,640 mg, elastin 20 mg, glutathione yeast 2 mg, biotin 20 µg
ssf.pros: 300 Da; 100 g collagen per box; jelly format.
ssf.cons: "100,000 mg" on front is the box total; only 4 mg vitamin C; mostly fruit concentrate (about 45 kcal per stick).

bb-goodnight.name: BB LAB Goodnight Collagen
bb-goodnight.pros: Adds glycine and proline, the main collagen amino acids; well-known brand.

bb-biotin.name: BB LAB Collagen Biotin Plus
bb-biotin.cons: Vitamin C 30 mg; biotin is the headline but adds no proven skin benefit.

boto.name: BOTO Glutathione White Collagen
boto.extras: Dried yeast with ≈25 mg glutathione, biotin 36 µg
boto.pros: 220 mg vitamin C; lowest box price; HACCP and Halal.
boto.cons: Collagen only 20% of stick (800 mg); 2,000 Da; glutathione far below useful dose.

mippeum.name: MIPPEUM Collagen Jelly Mix Package
mippeum.extras: Fruit concentrates (ABC juice, pomegranate, tart cherry) ≈18,400 mg
mippeum.pros: 1,600 mg collagen; under 600 Da; three flavours.
mippeum.cons: Most expensive per gram (₩594/g); no vitamin C declared; sugary fruit base.

hurum-biotin.name: HURUM Biotin Collagen Peptide
hurum-biotin.pros: 120 mg vitamin C; cheapest per stick (₩244).
hurum-biotin.cons: Only 500 mg collagen; Da not disclosed; tiny extras.

vitasub.name: VITASUB Slim Collagen Plus
vitasub.extras: Glutathione 0.2 mg, hyaluronic acid 0.02 mg, biotin 0.02 mg
vitasub.cons: About 196 mg collagen; 0.2 mg vitamin C; "whitening" icon on a general food; no price listed.
